summary.intent: Execute all 5 plans in Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the CipherBox project using the GSD manager, then run the full post-execution quality pipeline: code review, fixes, simplification, verification, and phase completion.
summary.outcome: Phase 50 was fully executed, verified, and marked complete. All 5 plans merged (50-01 through 50-05), 2 code-review blockers found and fixed, a simplification pass applied, both resolved pending todos closed, and the legacy todos/done/ folder consolidated into todos/completed/. The phase branch is 34 commits ahead of origin/main, ready for the security review and PR steps.

repo: Worktrees share the workspace root's node_modules — pnpm/orval resolves to the main checkout, so running pnpm api:generate inside a worktree writes 131 api-client files plus packages/sdk/src/client.ts into the orchestrator's working tree, blocking subsequent merges until the leaked copies are discarded.

Husky regenerates .husky/_/* hook stubs when pnpm install or api:generate runs in a worktree, leaving untracked files that cause the cleanup-wave helper to refuse the merge. Stubs must be cleaned before the helper is invoked.

The cleanup-wave helper silently fails its internal merge-commit step when lint-staged (eslint+prettier across 131 generated api-client files) takes too long. The fix is completing the merge manually with a generous timeout (600 s) — the staged content is already conflict-free.
gsd_run query commit reports commit_failed as a false-negative even when the commit lands. Always verify with git log rather than retrying.
The GSD init.manager dep-string parser mis-parses 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' into phantom phase 1.1, incorrectly marking Phase 50 deps as unsatisfied. The real dependency was complete.

todos/done/ (70 items, frozen since 2026-06-15) and todos/completed/ (20 items, current) are two names for the same concept. GSD tooling references todos/completed 6× and todos/done 0× — only completed/ is canonical. The 70 legacy items were never migrated when the convention changed.

The gsd phase.complete command surfaces pre-existing REQUIREMENTS traceability gaps (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08 missing from table) as warnings — these are prior doc-sync debt, not phase 50 regressions.
Two orphan worktree-agent-* branches (a92edd36, abd7998d) from a prior session remain in the repo with no associated worktrees — they are harmless but should be pruned.

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync had no visited set for cycle detection despite recursing at lines 220, 246, and 316. Its own docstring claimed to mirror the ensureFolderLoaded DFS pattern, which does carry a visited set (line 549). A folder cycle caused unbounded recursion → deleteItem failure.
After CR-01 fix: visited set added as param (line 286), guard check at line 293-294, child-skip at lines 327-341 — now mirrors the ensureFolderLoaded pattern correctly.
ensureFolderLoaded carries a visited set (line 549) and the shared DFS walker at line 2526 also does — these were the reference implementations that collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync should have matched.

50-02 added a refcount recheck guard at line 59 — skips physical unpin when CID is re-pinned. WR-01 follow-up: the advisory lock is now held across the Kubo network call in the drain path, which is a correctness win but a latency concern for the security review.

workflow: When a wave merge helper fails silently, inspect MERGE_HEAD — if it exists and no conflicts are shown (git diff --check / git status), the merge was applied cleanly but the commit step failed. Complete it manually with git commit and a generous timeout rather than aborting and retrying.

Before discarding leaked generated files from the orchestrator working tree, verify they are byte-identical to the worktree's committed version (git show worktree-branch:path vs git hash-object --stdin). Only then is it safe to restore them from HEAD.
Post-merge gate for a wave should use targeted test runs (specific changed test suites) rather than the full monorepo parallel suite to avoid RAM starvation and infra-dependent integration tests.

Key-link pre-wave dependency check false-positives occur when a link references the upcoming wave's own deliverable as a path — the parser treats the surrounding description text as a literal file path. Verify the actual source file exists separately.

The /simplify skill identifies helper extractions that can also consolidate error-handling boilerplate (e.g. four separate .catch handlers collapsed into one extracted helper), making it a useful second pass after code-review fixes that introduce repetition.

friction: cleanup-wave helper silently failed merge-commit for 50-05 because lint-staged ran eslint+prettier across 131 staged api-client files and apparently timed out or stalled internally — required manual git merge completion with a 600 s timeout.

Worktree node_modules sharing caused 131 api-client files and packages/sdk/src/client.ts to leak into the orchestrator working tree after 50-01/50-02 merged, blocking the 50-05 merge until the leaked copies were discarded.
Husky regenerated .husky/_/* stubs in the 50-05 worktree during pnpm api:generate, causing the cleanup-wave helper to reject the worktree as dirty.
gsd_run query commit false-negative commit_failed on wave tracking commits and phase completion required manual git log verification after each apparent failure.
GSD dep-string parser mis-parsed 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as phantom phase 1.1, making the manager dashboard show Phase 50 as dep-blocked when it was ready to execute.
